data.title: Add Blocked status for bugs
data.body:
## Goal

Add a `Blocked` status for bugs that are waiting on external dependencies.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Add `Blocked` variant to `Status` enum
- [ ] `docket block ID` transitions InProgress → Blocked
- [ ] `docket unblock ID` transitions Blocked → InProgress
- [ ] Blocked bugs show distinctly in `docket list` (e.g., red or with icon)
- [ ] `docket list --blocked` filters to only blocked bugs
- [ ] Optionally store a reason: `docket block ID --reason "waiting on API access"`

## Context

Currently there's no way to indicate a bug is stuck waiting on something external. You either leave it InProgress (misleading) or add a note to the body (easy to miss).

Status flow becomes:
```
Draft → Approved → InProgress ⇄ Blocked → Done
```

## Log
- 2026-01-14: Implemented Blocked status feature
  - Added `Blocked` variant to `Status` enum in bug.rs with proper serialization, display, parsing, and sort order
  - Added `Blocked` and `Unblocked` event types in event.rs with optional reason support
  - Added `blocked_reason` field to BugMetadata and accessor to Bug
  - Created `block` command: transitions InProgress → Blocked with optional `--reason` flag
  - Created `unblock` command: transitions Blocked → InProgress
  - Updated `list` command to show blocked bugs in red+bold, added `--blocked` filter flag
  - Updated `show` command to display blocked reason when present
  - Updated `log` command to display block/unblock events
  - Updated `work` command to warn when working on blocked bugs
  - Updated `sync` command to include blocked bugs in syncable workspaces
  - All tests pass, clippy clean
